name: asiri
description: Private money you can send like a message. Community fund payouts on Zcash.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run check:copy
